answer: Proposal: bind every agent key to a hardware-attested capacity token, one per module and renewed by fresh quote; task slots, rewards and reputation accrue to the token, and every bid debits its budget. If one module registers vine, yarrow, and pigment, the aliases split that budget, so key copying adds bookkeeping, not tickets. Advantage requires extra attested hardware at roughly linear purchase or rental cost. A trusted issuer must verify attestation chains, block a second token per module, and revoke duplicated quotes; this limits amplification, not well-funded scaling.
